# Liu2017

## Liu2017

```{r}
liu_samples_raw <- read.csv("~/Documents/ODSi/ODSiData/Liu2017/Metadata/meta_samples.csv",
                     stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)

liu_clinical_raw <- readxl::read_excel("~/Documents/ODSi/ODSiData/Liu2017/Metadata/meta_clinical.xlsx", col_types = "text")
```

```{r}
liu_clinical <- janitor::clean_names(liu_clinical_raw)%>%
  mutate(across(c(donor1_match, donor2_match), ~ case_when(
    # Detect if the cell contains only numbers (an Excel serial date)
    grepl("^[0-9]+$", .) ~ {
      # Convert the number to a Date object
      temp_date <- excel_numeric_to_date(as.numeric(.))
      
      # Extract the month and day, and paste them together with a slash
      paste0(month(temp_date), "/", day(temp_date))
    },
    
    # If it's already text (like "not applicable" or NA), leave it alone
    TRUE ~ .
  )))
```
